items.body: دموع قبل المعركة في لحظة إنسانية نادرة بعيداً عن صخب الأهداف والأرقام القياسية، عاش النجم الإنجليزي هاري كين صدمة عاطفية مؤثرة قبل ساعات من المواجهة الحاسمة التي تجمع بايرن ميونخ بآرسنال في دوري أبطال أوروبا. المهاجم البالغ من العمر 33 عاماً، والذي لطالما كان كابوساً لدفاع المدفعجية، والمرشح الأبرز للفوز بجائزة الكرة الذهبية المرموقة الأسبوع المقبل، لم يتمالك نفسه بعدما تلقى رسالة لم يكن يتوقعها. ورتبت شبكة "TNT Sports" مفاجأة خاصة لكين، الذي وافق الأسبوع الماضي على عقد ضخم جديد مع بايرن ميونخ، حيث قامت بالتواصل مع معلمه القديم في مدرسة تشينغفورد ليبعث له برسالة صوتية تشجيعية بعد بدايته المذهلة هذا الموسم. وبصوت مفعم بالفخر، قال السيد ليدون في رسالته التي أذيعت على الهواء: "مرحباً هاري، معك السيد ليدون.. أولاً، نيابة عن جميع منسوبي مدرسة تشينجفورد، أود أن أعرب عن فخرنا الكبير بك". وأضاف: "إن سجلك في الدوري الإنجليزي الممتاز مع توتنهام، وفي الدوري الألماني مع بايرن ميونيخ، وبالطبع مع إنجلترا، سواء من حيث الأهداف أو المشاركات، هو إنجاز رائع حقاً". واستكمل: "لكن الأمر يتجاوز ذلك، لقد مثّلت بلدنا بقيادة رائعة، وبصفتك قائدنا، كنت بحق قدوة ملهمة لآلاف اللاعبين الشباب الذين يطمحون للسير على خطاك، أتمنى لك التوفيق في جائزة الكرة الذهبية.. وتذكر، كما تقول الأغنية، ستظل دائماً واحداً منا". …

items.title: Nearly $1 million worth of PSA-graded Pokémon and other TCG have been stolen right outside PSA's headquarters
items.summary: Refunds will be issued to affected parties.
items.body: I don't send my Pokémon cards off to PSA to get graded. I'm too emotionally attached to my cards to ever sell them, so paying the hefty fee for grading doesn't really make sense for me, plus I'm a naturally anxious person. So when I heard the latest news of almost $1 million worth of TCG being stolen right outside PSA's headquarters my position was cemented. Police in Santa Ana, California have confirmed the theft of an estimated $963,000 worth of TCG after several card collectors were notified that a truck carrying their collections had been burglarised back in mid-October. (Image credit: The Pokémon Company) "The pallets contained various trading cards, including, but not limited to, sports cards and Pokémon cards," the SAPD explained to The Athletic . "The exact value of the stolen items has not yet been determined, pending further investigation. The investigation remains ongoing. items.title: GOG taken offline for maintenance in wake of PHP security emergency
items.summary: GOG and GOG Galaxy were taken offline following news of critical web vulnerabilities.
items.body: The reveal of critical vulnerabilities affecting the PHP scripting language used in web development have led a number of major websites and services to go offline today as a precaution while they apply security fixes. DRM-free game store GOG announced at 8 am Pacific that its site and launcher, GOG Galaxy, would be offline for "a couple of hours" for maintenance. The company did not say the cause, but it is not hard to speculate. We’re temporarily taking GOG offline for maintenance for a couple of hours. GOG GALAXY will also be offline during this time. We apologize for the inconvenience and appreciate your patience! October 21, 2026 Numerous other outages are being reported this morning as security teams scramble to protect their websites and services. The government of Finland took down websites as a precaution, for instance, and (perhaps less importantly) we're hearing from players that Final Fantasy 14 login servers are down.

items.title: Don't get hit with the BIOS update hammer for COD MW4 like my colleagues - here's how to ensure you can play multiplayer and DMZ
items.summary: TPM and Secure Boot requirements strike again.
items.body: If you're itching to get your pupils up against Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 on PC at launch on Friday, you should probably double-check your system is up to date. We've already had a couple of colleagues here flung against the wall of requirements with the new COD, requiring a BIOS update to play online. That's because Activision explains that both TPM 2.0 and Secure Boot are required to play any online game mode (multiplayer or DMZ). More specifically, though, you must have a new enough version of PTT (Platform Trust Technology) for Intel systems, and fTPM (Firmware Trusted Platform Module) for AMD ones. Secure Boot and TPM requirements themselves are part of the toolkit that many modern online games use to keep cheaters out. We've seen requirements for both , for instance, to play Battlefield 6. Secure Boot is what gives your firmware and kernel themselves signatures to ensure they are legit, and the TPM helps verify that everything boots up in order with no extra, malicious software or firmware thrust into the boot process. items.title: AMD has shipped FSR 4.1 early for RX 6000 graphics cards, and it's coming to Ryzen APUs, Vulkan, and Xbox too
items.summary: Better support is always a good thing.
items.body: If you are rocking an AMD graphics card or AMD laptop/handheld, there's good news. Not only will AMD be adding FSR 4.1 support to APUs and Xbox products in the future, but as of this week, it's also been added to Radeon RX 6000-series graphics cards. FSR is effectively AMD's answer to Nvidia's DLSS upscaling solution, and the latest generation (which has been supported on RX 7000-series cards since earlier this year ) offers performance and quality increases. Hyperscalers pushing forward with the big data centre build out will likely be jostling for the remaining 20%. As for Samsung's commodity memory output—your DRAM, your NAND, and so on—70% is already said to be covered by five year contracts. As a result, KB Securities predicts that the average selling price for this specialised memory will increase by between 100 and 150% year-over-year. items.title: Here's another gizmo to prevent your graphics card from melting - wouldn't it be nice if 12+4-pin connectors weren't a cause for concern at all?
items.summary: I'm thankful for accessories like this, but I wish it wasn't my problem to sort in the first place.
items.body: Power supply manufacturer Super Flower has launched a new accessory that sits between a graphics card and its power cable to ensure neither ends up a hot, expensive mess as too many Nvidia cards seem to be . It's called the VGA 12+4 pin OCP Dongle . It's a big lump of plastic and ARGB LEDs that measures for high current across the power pins that make up the 12V-2x6 (or 12VHPWR) connector. This connector is capable of delivering up to 600 watts—enough for an RTX 5090 —but it's overcurrent (a current that exceeds the cable/connectors ratings) that could cause a catastrophic failure. There are really six 'hot' +12V pins on the connector. That means each of those pins needs to carry around 8.33333 amps or thereabouts. That power load doesn't stay perfectly balanced between the pins, due to resistance and imperfections, which means some pins get less amps, while some get more amps. It's when they get a lot more amps that things start to get melty. Super Flower's OCP Dongle keeps a close watch on those amps, and will indicate when any pin exceeds 9.5 A.
